Vercel Pro is listed at $20 per month as a platform fee, which includes one deploying seat and $20 in monthly usage credit. Sources disagree on how seats are priced, so check the official pricing page before budgeting.

- **Official docs:** The Pro plan has a $20/month Pro platform fee, with 1 deploying team seat included.
- **Additional seats:** Extra deploying seats cost $20 each per month; Viewer seats are free.
- **Usage:** The plan includes 1 TB Fast Data Transfer and 10,000,000 Edge Requests each month. Usage beyond those allocations is charged against the monthly credit, and once you have used your monthly credit, Vercel bills additional usage on-demand.
- **Conflicting sources:** Several third-party guides describe Pro as $20 per user per month. That contradicts the per-seat model above, which is why I'd verify on vercel.com/pricing.
- **Plan transition:** Teams on the legacy Pro plan will be moved to the new pricing model later this year.

content.text:
Vercel's Pro plan costs **$20/month** as a platform fee.

- **Included in the fee:** one deploying seat and $20 of monthly usage credit.
- **Extra seats:** additional deploying seats cost $20 each per month. Viewer seats are free.
- **Included usage:** 1 TB of Fast Data Transfer and 10M Edge Requests (CDN requests) per month.
- **Overages:** usage beyond the included amounts draws down the $20 credit. After that it's billed pay-as-you-go with no cap. Examples from the pricing page:
  - CDN requests: from $2 per 1M
  - Fast Data Transfer: from $0.15/GB
  - Function invocations: from $0.60 per 1M
  - Fluid Active CPU: from $0.128/hour
  - Basic build minutes: $0.007/minute

Some third-party guides describe Pro as "$20 per user per month". The official docs describe a $20 platform fee that includes one seat, with extra seats at $20 each. The docs also say teams on the legacy Pro plan will be moved to the new model later this year, which may explain the mismatch. The pricing page didn't spell out how the credit applies to seats versus the base fee, so confirm that on the page before budgeting.

Sources:
- [Vercel Pricing](https://vercel.com/pricing)
- [Vercel Pro Plan docs](https://vercel.com/docs/plans/pro-plan)
- [Pricing on Vercel](https://docs.vercel.com/docs/pricing)
